Answers recorded from a real Plex Media Server 1.43.5.11079-b3b13e506 installed by the recipe in a throwaway
container (unclaimed, nothing in its library), with the machine identifier and library ids replaced by invented ones.
The server answers /services/browse/<base64 path> only with ?includeFiles=0, and lists HardwareAcceleratedCodecs
among its preferences only for an account with a Plex Pass.
